page.overview:
Who is Chlamydosaurus sputori?

Chlamydosaurus sputori was a bio-engineered dinosaur species planned to appear in the cut Jurassic Park 4. These "spitters" are large and have the ability to dig, like the Excavaraptor. Dilophosaurus would also be retconned for Chlamydosaurus.

The Dilophosaurus would be retconned as Chlamydosaurus sputori in the John Sayles script of Jurassic Park 4. The ones at Jurassic Park took on prey such as unlucky humans. The Dilophosaurus that killed Dennis Nedry would be a Chlamydosaurus.

For Jurassic Park 4, they would have been used instead of Dilophosaurus. In the abandoned script, they were first seen in a flashback, where one kills Nedry, retconning the Dilophosaurus from the first movie as a member of this species. When Nick arrived at Isla Nublar, he entered the nesting area of the Chlamydosaurus. During his escape, a Chlamydosaurus was caught and eaten by an Excavaraptor. Later, two called Casper and Pollux are seen being trained by Nick, alongside the genetically engineered Deinonychus. In the end of the abandoned script, they escape, killing a man called Pepe. They attempt to attack Nick, but run off into the jungle.
